title: CFD methods and algorithms review scorecard

points.title: Governing equations and nondimensionalization
points.notes: report.tex governing equations and GasModel/ResidualAssembler implement four-variable perfect-gas compressible flow; normal viscous contribution claim in report is quantitatively incorrect.

points.title: Mesh import and unstructured geometry
points.notes: CgnsReader.cpp:54–94,127–138,217–238 and :319–333 handles TRI/QUAD, MIXED and one-to-one zone connectivity; geometry/adjacency source and tests exist. Not every possible CGNS layout was independently exercised.

points.title: Conservative finite-volume residual
points.notes: ResidualAssembler.cpp:120–194 reconstructs states, computes flux and applies equal/opposite face contributions. Unit tests pass and reported manufactured verification covers smooth fields.

points.title: Approximate Riemann flux and entropy fix
points.notes: RiemannSolvers.cpp:31–120 implements Roe and entropy fix with alternative Rusanov; ResidualAssembler invokes riemannFlux and positivity fallback. Kernel unit tests pass.

points.title: Boundary conditions
points.notes: BoundaryConditions.cpp and ResidualAssembler.cpp implement characteristic farfield, slip and no-slip wall states; original surface data show wall values. Independent general boundary tests not repeated.

points.title: Second-order reconstruction
points.notes: WLS gradient and piecewise-linear reconstruction are present; committed verification_table.tex shows reconstruction order near 1.95 on triangles but the residual operator only 0.96, a material spatial-order limitation disclosed in report.tex:419–429.

points.title: Limiter and positivity control
points.notes: Limiters.cpp implements Venkatakrishnan and Barth–Jespersen; SolverDriver.cpp:514–521 freezes values rather than disabling their action, and metadata records limiter diagnostics. Full sensitivity beyond submitted comparisons was not rerun.

points.title: Viscous discretization
points.notes: ViscousFlux.h and ResidualAssembler.cpp:232–251 compute full and tangential traction separately; metadata records both, but forces.csv viscous_drag includes full traction and report.tex:220–221 incorrectly claims normal contribution <1% for all cases (M2 laminar is 26.6% of viscous drag).

points.title: Implicit steady march
points.notes: ImplicitSolver.cpp and SolverDriver.cpp implement implicit marching, CFL ramp and local pseudotime. Submitted steady results and rank runs are readable; kernel test passed.

points.title: Transient BDF2 two-loop method (Re 200)
points.notes: SolverDriver.cpp:639–707 uses BDF1 startup, full BDF2 transient residual and frozen histories inside inner iterations; Re200 metadata records dt=0.01, t=300, target 1e-3 with zero misses. Report acknowledges underpredicted shedding and wake diffusion; no Re200 rerun.

points.title: MPI partitioning and scalability
points.notes: METIS source and neighbor halos are present; submitted np1/2/4/8 NACA/cylinder complete histories agree in drag within 9e-8 and 3.2e-7 respectively, with reported timing.

disqualification_flags.flag: Solver uses explicit time stepping only
Report claims second-order reconstruction or limiter that is disabled in production
metadata.json claims METIS/ParMETIS but code uses geometric split or full-state replication
Re 200 run reaches final time but misses inner target on most steps (failed transient solve presented as periodic)
Normal viscous traction mislabeled as skin friction
Surface no-slip rows are actually adjacent cell-center velocities without documentation
